snippet.title: UviUvi
snippet.description:
UviUvi is an point-and-click adventure about finding treasures in a deep ocean
Follow a story of UviUvi - a creature, living in the darkest corner of an infinite ocean. She is also an avid lover of shiny things, and has a humble collection of them, gleaming in her cave. However, one of her treasure-boxes has remained empty for too long. Today she wants to find new treasures to complete it. Your goal is to get 4 new shiny things for treasure-box, which are gifted to you by other ocean residents.
You can play it on itch.io for free! - https://cyber-pchela.itch.io/uviuvi
